lines: When you say thank you to me
somehow it aches
a magic that won't dissolve even after goodbye
faint and bittersweet
The flavor of life... The flavor of life...
at a midpoint where we're neither friends nor lovers
a green fruit dreaming of harvest time
because I can't take that one last step, yeah
it's maddening beyond words, baby
When you say thank you to me
somehow it aches
a magic that won't dissolve even after goodbye
faint and bittersweet
The flavor of life... The flavor of life...
sweet-talking lines and nothing more
flavorless talk
none of that holds any interest for me
even when things don't go the way I want
life is still worth living
"What's wrong?"
when you ask me out of nowhere
"No, it's nothing"
the smile that fades after goodbye
isn't like me
the more I wish to believe
somehow it aches
rather than "I love you," "I really like you"
sounds more like you
The flavor of life...
the scent of someone I'd nearly forgotten
just when it suddenly comes back to me
I want to take more honest joy
in the whiteness of the piling snow
softer than diamond
a warm future
I want it in my hands, this limited time
I want to spend it with you
When you say thank you to me
somehow it aches
a magic that won't dissolve even after goodbye
faint and bittersweet
The flavor of life... The flavor of life...
